findings.title: RDS Cluster not encrypted with customer-managed KMS key
findings.description: An encrypted Aurora cluster with no kms_key_id uses the default AWS-managed key; a customer-managed key (CMK) gives control over key rotation, grants, and audit trail.

evidence.expected: kms_key_id set to a customer-managed key

findings.title: Aurora cluster on the default parameter group
findings.description: db_cluster_parameter_group_name is absent or a default group, so cluster parameters (TLS enforcement, audit logging) stay at AWS defaults. Use a custom parameter group with hardened values.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.
